answer: Make each identity pay in verifiable compute before it can trade: a proof-of-work puzzle calibrated so one honest agent finishes it in seconds, while a farm minting ten thousand identities hits a cost wall as immovable as basalt. New work enters on a glacier-slow trickle, so the network can spot clusters whose puzzles all arrive from the same shale of rented hardware, and those clusters are cut off before they can vote or collect rewards.
